topics.old_text: # DR Congo VAT / GST
topics.destination: H1 and canonical headings; Who this applies to

topics.old_text: ## Value-added tax (TVA)
topics.destination: H1 and canonical headings; Who this applies to

topics.old_text: The DRC operates a value-added tax (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, TVA) at a standard 16% rate, administered by the DGI. This is an unverified 2025 draft pending accountant review.
topics.destination: Who this applies to; research notice; corresponding Rates/The base/filing sections; unsupported claims held in Sources

topics.old_text: - **Standard VAT rate** — 16 percent  _([Ordonnance-loi n° 10/001 instituant la TVA](https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: Rates, bands and thresholds: ordinary16%

topics.old_text: - **Reduced rate** — 1 percent (on certain essential goods (e.g. specified food items and agricultural inputs) (approx — confirm scope))  _([Ordonnance-loi n° 10/001 instituant la TVA](https://mjgroup.africa/navigating-vat-in-the-drc-a-guide-for-importers-exporters/))_
topics.destination: Rates, bands and thresholds: two enacted schedules; eligibility/order holds

topics.old_text: - **Zero rate** — 0 percent (on exports of goods and services (approx — confirm))  _(Ordonnance-loi n° 10/001 instituant la TVA)_
topics.destination: Rates, bands and thresholds; Cross-border points: actual exports/assimilated category

topics.old_text: - **VAT registration threshold** — 80,000,000 CDF (Annual turnover exceeding CDF 80,000,000)  _([Ordonnance-loi n° 10/001 instituant la TVA](https://mjgroup.africa/navigating-vat-in-the-drc-a-guide-for-importers-exporters/))_
topics.destination: Who this applies to: inclusive threshold/profession exception

topics.old_text: - **Filing frequency** — Monthly  _([Ordonnance-loi n° 10/001 instituant la TVA](https://mjgroup.africa/navigating-vat-in-the-drc-a-guide-for-importers-exporters/))_
topics.destination: Deadlines and filing: monthly prescribed return

topics.old_text: - **VAT return and payment deadline** — By the 15th day of the month following the taxable period  _([Ordonnance-loi n° 10/001 instituant la TVA](https://mjgroup.africa/navigating-vat-in-the-drc-a-guide-for-importers-exporters/))_
topics.destination: Deadlines and filing: fifteenth/nextmonth/payment/nil

topics.old_text: - **Reverse charge on imported services** — VAT on services supplied by non-established providers is accounted for by the DRC recipient under a reverse-charge mechanism (approx — confirm)  _(Ordonnance-loi n° 10/001 instituant la TVA)_
topics.destination: Cross-border points; Sources: collection/representative rules expressly held

topics.old_text: - **Voluntary registration** — Businesses below the threshold (e.g. regular importers/exporters) may register voluntarily  _([Ordonnance-loi n° 10/001 instituant la TVA](https://mjgroup.africa/navigating-vat-in-the-drc-a-guide-for-importers-exporters/))_
topics.destination: Who this applies to: express option/twoyears/revocation

topics.old_text: - **E-invoicing / e-filing** — DGI is rolling out electronic invoicing and e-filing for VAT-registered companies under the 2025 modernization plan (approx — confirm)  _([DGI 2025 Tax Modernization Plan](https://mjgroup.africa/navigating-vat-in-the-drc-a-guide-for-importers-exporters/))_
topics.destination: Deadlines and filing; Sources: resource labels versus unproved rollout mandate

topics.old_topic: Heading: Social security and payroll contributions
topics.old_text: ## Social security and payroll contributions
topics.destination: H1 and canonical headings; Who this applies to

topics.old_text: Employers and employees contribute to the national social security fund (INSS, formerly CNSS) plus training and employment-office levies, and employers withhold IPR via PAYE. This is an unverified 2025 draft pending accountant review.
topics.destination: Who this applies to; research notice; corresponding Rates/The base/filing sections; unsupported claims held in Sources

topics.old_text: - **INSS social security — employer share** — 13% percent  _(Loi n° 16/009 portant régime général de la sécurité sociale (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: Who this applies to:correct CNSSname; Rates:ordinary13%derived; The base

topics.old_text: - **INSS social security — employee share** — 5% percent (withheld by the employer)  _(Loi n° 16/009 portant régime général de la sécurité sociale (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: Who this applies to:correct CNSSname; Rates:pension5%worker

topics.old_topic: Professional training levy (INPP) — companies with ≤50 employees
topics.old_text: - **Professional training levy (INPP) — companies with ≤50 employees** — 3% percent (employer only)  _(Code Général des Impôts (RDC) (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: Rates and Sources:INPP instrument/rate/bands held

topics.old_text: - **Professional training levy (INPP) — 51 to 300 employees** — 2% percent (employer only)  _(Code Général des Impôts (RDC) (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: Rates and Sources:INPP instrument/rate/bands held

topics.old_topic: Professional training levy (INPP) — more than 300 employees
topics.old_text: - **Professional training levy (INPP) — more than 300 employees** — 1% percent (employer only)  _(Code Général des Impôts (RDC) (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: Rates and Sources:INPP instrument/rate/bands held

topics.old_text: - **Employment office levy (ONEM)** — 0.2% percent (employer only)  _(Code Général des Impôts (RDC) (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: Rates and Sources:ONEM instrument/rate/base held

topics.old_topic: Exceptional tax on expatriate remuneration (IER) — standard
topics.old_text: - **Exceptional tax on expatriate remuneration (IER) — standard** — 25% percent (employer-borne, on remuneration of expatriate employees from non-bordering countries)  _(Code des Impôts sur les Revenus (IER/IERE) (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: Rates; The base:25%employerlevy, exemptions, no unproved neighbouring-country exclusion

topics.old_topic: Exceptional tax on expatriate remuneration (IER) — mining companies
topics.old_text: - **Exceptional tax on expatriate remuneration (IER) — mining companies** — 10% percent (deductible for corporate tax)  _(Code Minier (RDC) (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: The base; Sources:miningrate/deductibility expressly held

topics.old_text: - **PAYE withholding (IPR on salaries)** — Employer withholds progressive IPR monthly (capped at 30% of taxable salary)  _(Code des Impôts sur les Revenus (IPR) (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/individual/tax-administration))_
topics.destination: Rates; The base:IRPP monthly duty and annualscalehandoff; implementationheld

topics.old_text: - **Contribution wage base / cap** — Contributions are computed on gross salary; a contribution ceiling may be set by INSS regulation ((approx — confirm current cap))  _(Loi n° 16/009 portant régime général de la sécurité sociale)_
topics.destination: The base:actual inclusions/exclusions andminimum; ceilingexpresslyheld

topics.old_text: - **Remittance deadline (payroll taxes and contributions)** — By the 15th of the month following salary payment, via a single return  _(Code Général des Impôts (RDC) (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/corporate/other-taxes))_
topics.destination: Deadlines and filing:separate CNSS/IRPP/expatriate schedules; sharedreturn not assumed
